summary: Operationalize Generation 10 free-first technology evolution with a canonical source-of-truth contract, an official-source Technology Radar, deterministic value/cost/security scoring, bounded sandbox admission, evidence retention, and integration into the existing Autonomous Discovery signal path.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly directed EKODI to autonomously introduce, apply and operate current best technology step-by-step on a free-based, low-cost, efficient basis, requesting only decisions or authority that are genuinely necessary.
constitutionalInterpretation: This is an implementation of the existing Generation 10 Self-Architecture Optimization and S0 sustainability rules. It narrows evidence and cost gates and does not grant new production, financial, secret, permission, constitutional or generation-promotion authority.
implementedCapabilities: Canonical platform source-of-truth precedence for autonomous planning
Free-first and low-cost S0 hard gates
Material provider/standard changes routed into the existing Autonomous Discovery Engine
Weekly low-noise scheduled radar with 90-day evidence retention
Persistent attention issue only when material candidates exist
No-fabrication behavior when official evidence is unavailable
authorityImpact: None. Technology research is autonomous within delegated read-only and bounded experiment scope. Paid activation, secrets, permission expansion, provider lock-in, direct production mutation, constitutional change and generation promotion remain human-governed.
costImpact: No new paid service or fixed infrastructure commitment. The implementation reuses existing GitHub Actions and public official release APIs.
rollback: Disable or remove the autonomous technology radar workflow and new policy/engine files. Existing Generation 10 Autonomous Discovery, Evolution Loop, provider routing and guarded release paths remain unchanged.
